AD2E.Character.Name: Name
AD2E.Test.NotAvailable: {test} is not available at this ability score.

AD2E.Class.OtherRequirements: This kit also has race, alignment or other restrictions; see the linked page.
AD2E.Class.DropKit: Drag a Class Kit item here
AD2E.Class.DragHint: Drag a Race, a Class and then a Class Kit from the Items directory or the "Races (PHB)", "Classes (PHB)" and "Class Kits" compendiums onto this sheet. Dropping a new one replaces the current one.
AD2E.Class.NeedClassFirst: Add a Class before adding a Class Kit.
AD2E.Class.KitDoesNotFit: This kit is not available to the current class.

AD2E.Item.kitClassesHint: Comma-separated class identifiers, e.g. fighter, paladin
AD2E.Item.otherRequirements: Has race, alignment or other restrictions
AD2E.Item.kitMinHint: Overrides the class minimum for that ability. Blank keeps the class minimum; 0 removes it.

AD2E.Save.OverrideHint: Override (blank uses PHB Table 60 for the class group and level)

AD2E.HP.Fixed: +{hp} HP (fixed; no hit die or CON bonus at this level)
AD2E.HP.ConfirmReset: This character is above 1st level. Replace current and maximum HP with a new 1st-level roll?
AD2E.HP.XpRestart: hierophant druid: counted from 1 XP after stepping down as Grand Druid at 16th level

AD2E.Race.InfravisionByLineage: Infravision depends on lineage (see source page)
AD2E.Race.ConSaves: CON bonus vs. rod/staff/wand and spells (Table 9)
AD2E.Race.SaveBonus: Racial CON bonus (Table 9), added to the roll
AD2E.Race.PoisonBonus: Racial CON bonus vs. poison only (Table 9)
AD2E.Race.RolledScore: Rolled score (checked against the race's Table 7 limits)
AD2E.Race.EffectiveScore: Effective score: rolled + racial adjustment (Table 8); used for all tables and rolls
AD2E.Race.ClassNotAllowed: This race cannot take the current class.
AD2E.Race.LevelLimitReached: This race cannot advance beyond level {limit} in this class. Edit the level directly if your DM allows it.
AD2E.Race.KitRaceLimitsHint: race level, comma-separated, e.g. dwarf 15, gnome 6 (no number = unlimited)
AD2E.Race.NeedsRaceKit: {race} can only be a {class} through a kit that allows {race}; add one.
AD2E.Race.NeedsKitNote: This race can only take this class through a kit that allows the race; add a qualifying kit.
AD2E.Race.KitNotForRace: {kit} is not available to {race} for this class.

AD2E.Prof.CrossGroup: Outside this class's proficiency groups (Table 38): +1 slot
AD2E.Prof.CheckHint: Proficiency check: 1d20 ≤ this number (a 20 always fails)
AD2E.Prof.DragHint: Drag proficiencies from the "Proficiencies" compendium onto this sheet. Adding a Class Kit adds its bonus proficiencies (free) and required proficiencies (use slots); removing the kit removes its bonus proficiencies.
AD2E.Prof.ChooseOne: Choose one proficiency granted by this kit.

AD2E.Weapon.NoDamage: {name} has no damage listed on the PHB weapon list.
AD2E.Weapon.Specialize: Weapon specialization (fighters only): one extra slot, two for bows
AD2E.Weapon.SpecInvalid: Specialization requires a single-class fighter and a single specialized weapon
AD2E.Weapon.NoWeaponData: No weapon data; remove and re-add this proficiency from the compendium
AD2E.Weapon.PointBlankHint: Point blank range available (+2 to hit)
AD2E.Weapon.DropNotProficient: {name}: no matching weapon proficiency; attacks take the non-proficiency penalty ({penalty}).
AD2E.Weapon.DragHint: Weight of weapons, ammunition and armour counts toward encumbrance. Drag armour from the "Armour (PHB)" compendium and weapons and ammunition from the "Weapons (PHB)" compendium onto this sheet. A weapon uses the weapon proficiency with the same identifier; specialization is set on the proficiency. Firing a launcher uses one piece of the chosen ammunition; throwing a weapon uses one from its quantity.

AD2E.Ammo.LaunchersHint: Fired from: comma-separated weapon identifiers (e.g. long-bow, short-bow).
AD2E.Ammo.None: {name}: no ammunition left. Add ammunition that fits it, or raise its quantity.

AD2E.Armor.RearHint: Attacks from behind: no shield, no beneficial Dexterity adjustment
AD2E.Armor.Unused: Another equipped item of this kind gives a better AC; this one is not counted

AD2E.Enc.MagicArmorHint: Magical armour counts toward the most weight that can be carried, not toward movement or combat (Encumbrance (PHB))
AD2E.Enc.OverMax: Over the most weight that can be carried: cannot move
AD2E.Enc.SettingHint: PHB optional rules: basic categories (Table 47), specific movement (Table 48), or off.

AD2E.Move.Hint: Movement rate: tens of feet per round in dungeons, tens of yards per round outdoors (Movement (PHB))
AD2E.Move.SneakHint: Cautious (dungeon) pace: movement rate in tens of feet per round (Movement (PHB)). Thief Move Silently is a separate skill.
AD2E.Move.WalkHint: Walking pace: movement rate in tens of yards per round; at this pace in a dungeon, -1 to surprise rolls, +1 to others' chance of being surprised, and traps are not noticed (Movement (PHB))
AD2E.Move.CombatHint: Combat round: movement x 10 ft. Close to melee and attack: {close} ft; withdraw: {withdraw} ft; charge: {charge} ft (+2 to hit, AC +1, no Dexterity bonus) (Movement in Combat (PHB))
AD2E.Move.JogHint: Double movement in yards; {rounds} rounds (Constitution), then a Constitution check each round (Movement (PHB))
AD2E.Move.RunHint: x3 with a Strength check, x4 with a Strength check at -4; Constitution check each round at -1 (x3) / -2 (x4) per round run, cumulative (Movement (PHB))
AD2E.Move.SprintHint: x5 with a Strength check at -8; Constitution check each round at -3 per round, cumulative (Movement (PHB))
AD2E.Move.JumpHint: Jumping proficiency (PHB): running broad / running high · standing broad / standing high (ft); 20 ft running start; click to roll
AD2E.Move.NoJump: The PHB gives jump distances only for the Jumping proficiency
AD2E.Move.BroadCap: no more than six times the character's height
AD2E.Move.HighCap: no more than 1 1/2 times the character's height
AD2E.Move.MarchHint: Miles per 10-hour day: march (x2) / force march (x2 1/2, Constitution check each day) (Movement (PHB))

AD2E.Coin.Hint: Exchange (PHB Table 42): 1 pp = 5 gp, 1 gp = 2 ep = 10 sp = 100 cp. Coins of any metal weigh 50 to the pound (DMG) and count toward encumbrance.
AD2E.Coin.NoneYet: No coins yet. Drag coins from the "Equipment (PHB)" compendium; a dropped stack joins an owned stack of the same coin.

AD2E.Gear.CarriedHint: Carried items count toward encumbrance (weight x quantity)
AD2E.Gear.LoadFull: Animal load at full move (lb, PHB Table 49)
AD2E.Gear.NoneYet: No gear yet. Drag items from the "Equipment (PHB)" compendium.

AD2E.Monster.HitDiceHint: As written in the Monstrous Manual: 3, 3+3, 1-1, 1/2, 2-8 hp. Hit Dice are d8.
AD2E.Monster.MoraleHint: Morale check: 2d10, the creature stands on a total at or below its morale (Morale (DMG))
AD2E.Monster.SaveLevelHint: Save level = Hit Dice (+1 per 4 added points or fraction); non-intelligent creatures use half except vs. paralyzation, poison and death magic (The Saving Throw (DMG))
AD2E.Monster.InventoryHint: Drag weapons, armour, equipment and coins here. Equipped armour sets AC; weapons add attacks; carried weight counts toward a mount's load.
AD2E.Monster.NoAttacks: No attacks: add one, or drag a weapon onto the sheet.

AD2E.Importer.Title: Monster importer (Complete Compendium)
AD2E.Importer.MenuHint: Import monster stat blocks from completecompendium.com into this world as Monster / NPC actors, by setting and source book.
AD2E.Importer.Hint: Imports stat blocks (game statistics) and a link to each monster's page; the descriptions stay on the site. Source:
AD2E.Importer.Folder: Put new actors in a folder named after the book
AD2E.Importer.SomeFailed: {n} monster page(s) could not be loaded: {keys}
